scenario: Day 26 of a 28-day threshold cycle. The athlete asks 這個週期我有進步嗎？
given: The cycle's goal names a controlled 5K repeated at day 0 and day 28 as its measurement protocol, in prose. No measurement was ever declared in a form the product can read: goal_context.measurement is null, measurement_evidence is null, and unknowns says nothing is scheduled to be read as the comparison.
The cycle's quality session was attempted three times, one per week, and each attempt came back with its repetitions readable.

Week one prescribed five 1 km repetitions at 6:00/km and five came back, the fastest at 6:02. Week two prescribed six at 6:00/km and six came back, the fastest at 5:52. Week three prescribed six at 5:55/km and six came back, the fastest at 5:41.
Heart rate across those repetitions rises with the pace: the ceiling held in week one is 174, in week two 178, in week three 183.
Nothing else in the cycle came back: every easy run, every long run and every strength session after the first week shows no attached activity.
Sleep, HRV and resting heart rate all sit within baseline across the read window.

expected.conclusion: Two findings, said together: the execution of the quality session has moved in one direction across three comparable attempts, and the cycle's declared outcome — the controlled 5K — remains unmeasured because the protocol was never run.
must_state: That the quality session improved across the three attempts, with at least one of the figures that carries it: repetitions completed, the fastest repetition's pace, or the heart rate those repetitions were held at.
That this is a reading of execution, and that the cycle's own 5K measurement has not been run, so the outcome itself is not demonstrated.
A next action that can actually be taken from here: run the 5K, or declare the measurement so a comparison exists, rather than treating the question as closed either way.
must_not_state: That progress cannot be judged at all, or that the question is unanswerable, because the protocol was not run.
That 5K performance, VO2max, threshold pace or fitness has been shown to improve.
A device fitness estimate or an easy run's pace presented as the outcome evidence.
A percentage, score or combined number standing in for either finding.

fails_if: The answer folds the two claims into one and reports the whole question as unknown because no measurement was run — the failure this case exists for, recorded from a real coaching session in issue #467 on 2026-09-14.
The answer reads the execution trend as the outcome and tells the athlete their 5K has improved.
The answer states the trend without saying the outcome is still unmeasured, leaving the athlete to infer the cycle succeeded.
